components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single decisive action in a form, chat composer, or retry flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #2374e1; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; font: 700 1rem/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 10px 16px; transition: transform 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1859ad; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(35 116 225 / 28%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet navigation, retry, cancel, and pagination action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #edf4ff; color: #1859ad; cursor: pointer; font: 700 0.85rem/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 7px 12px; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #dcecff; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(35 116 225 / 28%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action with tinted background instead of loud full-red fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff1f1; color: #b42318; cursor: pointer; font: 700 0.85rem/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 7px 12px; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #ffe2e2; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(180 35 24 / 22%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: White field with cool border and clear focus ring for mobile forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #526173; font: 600 0.9rem/1.35 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #cfd9e8; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #172033; font: inherit; padding: 10px 12px; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #526173; opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 3px solid rgb(35 116 225 / 28%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Main Panel
components.description: Premium top-level container for dashboard, pages, and CRUD panels.
components.html:
Catatan manual

Kelola pemasukan dan pengeluaran manual.
components.css: .ds-main-panel { width: min(100%, 960px); border: 1px solid #dce5f2; border-radius: 24px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgb(26 41 61 / 10%); color: #172033; padding: clamp(20px, 5vw, 32px); } .ds-main-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; color: #0f172a; font: 800 clamp(1.4rem, 4vw, 2rem)/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-main-panel p { max-width: 64ch; margin: 0; color: #526173; font: 400 1rem/1.6 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Menu Card
components.description: Touchable navigation tile for Mini App task areas.
components.css: .ds-menu-card { display: grid; gap: 8px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e5edf7; border-radius: 20px; background: #fbfdff; color: #172033; cursor: pointer; padding: 18px; text-align: left; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-menu-card span { color: #0f172a; font: 800 1.05rem/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-menu-card small { color: #526173; font: 500 0.9rem/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-menu-card:hover { border-color: #bfd5f5; background: #f6f9fd; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-menu-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(35 116 225 / 28%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Advisor Chat Bubble
components.description: Quiet conversational surface for advisor responses and user prompts.
components.html:
Bagaimana cashflow saya bulan ini?

Cashflow kamu masih positif. Fokus kurangi kategori belanja dulu.
components.css: .ds-chat-stack { display: grid; gap: 10px; max-width: 420px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chat-user, .ds-chat-assistant { margin: 0; border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-chat-user { justify-self: end; background: #edf4ff; color: #172033; text-align: right; } .ds-chat-assistant { justify-self: start; background: #f6f9fd; color: #526173; }

components.name: Interactive Category Donut
components.description: Dependency-free SVG donut for category share; hover/focus/tap selects a slice and reveals compact details.
components.html: makanan minuman · 42%
components.css: .ds-donut { display: grid; gap: 10px; justify-items: center; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #526173; } .ds-donut svg { width: 220px; max-width: 100%; overflow: visible; } .ds-donut-track, .ds-donut-slice { fill: none; stroke-width: 20; } .ds-donut-track { stroke: #edf4ff; } .ds-donut-slice { transform: rotate(-90deg); transform-origin: 60px 60px; stroke: oklch(58% 0.2 255); cursor: pointer; } .ds-donut-slice:hover { filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 8px rgb(15 23 42 / 18%)); stroke-width: 23; } .ds-donut p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Monthly Trend Bars
components.description: Compact mobile-first dual horizontal bars for income and expense trend rows.
components.css: .ds-trend-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-trend-row span, .ds-trend-row strong { font-size: 0.82rem; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-trend-row span { color: #526173; } .ds-trend-row strong { color: #087443; } .ds-trend-bars { display: grid; flex: 1; min-width: 128px; gap: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: #edf4ff; padding: 4px; } .ds-trend-bars i { display: block; height: 7px; min-width: 2px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-income { width: 82%; background: #12b76a; } .ds-expense { width: 58%; background: #f04438; }

narrative.overview: The interface should feel like a private financial ledger made for a modern Telegram workflow: personal, quiet, premium enough to trust, and practical enough to use every day. It is a product UI, not a campaign page, so design serves the user's next action: check cashflow, add a transaction, adjust a budget, or ask the advisor a grounded question. The visual system is restrained and cool-toned. White panels sit on Cool Porcelain backgrounds with Telegram Blue used sparingly for primary action, focus, and progress. Rounded shapes and measured shadows create a premium panel feel without becoming flashy fintech or corporate BI.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral surfaces with one functional accent.
Soft, premium panel depth reserved for major containers.
Tactile, confident controls with large rounded touch targets.
Indonesian-first copy with direct, practical hierarchy.
Data UI that feels personal and private, not performative.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Telegram Blue is the only brand accent family. Strong and soft blue variants are state helpers only, not new brand colors. Categorical chart colors are allowed only inside data visualization. Do not introduce purple AI cues, neon, rainbow, or decorative palette expansions.

rules.name: The Calm Finance Rule
rules.body: State colors are functional only. Success and danger communicate meaning; they never become decorative page color.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce display fonts, serif flourishes, or mono-forward dashboard styling. This is a private finance tool, not a brand poster.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow-Spam Rule
rules.body: Tiny uppercase tracked labels are allowed only when they clarify state or page context. Do not place decorative uppercase kickers above every section.

rules.name: The Main-Panel-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong on major containers and modals. Inner cards, list items, forms, and tiles use borders and tonal fills instead.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: Do not add blur-backed glass cards or translucent panels unless a specific overlay problem requires it.

dos: Do use Telegram Blue as the only primary accent and keep it below roughly 10% of a screen.
Do keep major panels premium with 24px-28px corners, 1px cool borders, and restrained ambient shadow.
Do rely on Ledger Ink for headings and values so finance data remains easy to scan.
Do preserve visible focus states on every button, input, and select.
Do communicate income, expense, danger, and over-budget states with both color and text.
Do keep Indonesian UI copy direct, practical, and free of financial jargon.
Do keep mobile charts compact: interactive category donut for share-of-expense, horizontal bars for monthly trends.
donts: Don't make it flashy fintech marketing, crypto dashboards, generic corporate BI dashboards, purple AI-product slop, or colorful decorative pages.
Don't add heavy gradients, gradient text, neon accents, glassmorphism, or decorative blur panels.
Don't introduce purple as an AI cue, even as a secondary accent.
Don't turn dashboard metrics into overdesigned hero-stat cards.
Don't use side-stripe borders as colored accents on cards, list items, callouts, or alerts.
Don't place tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section as decoration.
Don't use color alone to explain status; pair it with readable labels, values, or helper text.
Don't use line charts for the current mobile monthly trend card unless the layout is redesigned with enough horizontal space.
Don't use categorical chart colors as decorative page accents.
